backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260512-110 policy semantics.
decision_rationale: The production registry `liquidity_tier=watch` scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must remain shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe. Registry liquidity_tier is production-observable, but any accepted change must remain default-off until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale official Space signals whose registry liquidity_tier is watch.

2_history_check.exp-20260512-023: Rejected GSAT candidate-pool expansion; no ticker expansion here.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-037: Accepted liquidity_tier=ok 1.10x anchor scalar. This run tests the complementary watch bucket on top of the later accepted exp-110 stack, not a retune of the ok scalar.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-109: Rejected generic cumulative risk cap; this run is bucket-specific and production-observable, not a broad cap.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-110: Accepted company-release customer-source 1.10x scalar; this is the fixed before state.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_watch_liquidity_tier_risk_scalar. Candidate pool, accepted Space stack, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 total trades, nonzero adjusted watch-liquidity signals, and non-1.0 scalar.

hypothesis: After the accepted liquidity_tier=ok anchor top-up and company-release source scalar, the complementary `watch` liquidity bucket may still carry different risk-adjusted replacement value. A bounded scalar can test whether lower-liquidity official Space signals deserve haircut or small top-up without changing candidate pool, ranking, LLM/news, targets, stops, or live slots.
interpretation: The production registry `liquidity_tier=watch` scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must remain shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate; this run uses deterministic production registry metadata.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, stop nearby liquidity-tier scalar mining on the same frozen snapshots. Future Space work should test forward replacement value by catalyst family/source quality or add higher-coverage official catalyst attribution without noisy ticker additions.
single_causal_variable: risk scalar for official Space signals keyed only to production universe-registry liquidity_tier == watch
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking is data-limited; broad source splits, generic risk caps, peer leadership, and noisy ticker expansion have already failed or are underpowered. This tests a single production-visible risk-allocation field on top of the current accepted Space stack.
